summary: Full test of Timetable module (Phases 1-4) + Notices + Report Cards on LNMO ERP. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py — 43/43 passing (timetable config CRUD/upsert/unit-override, grid, complete conflict engine matrix, teacher-grid, portal timetable, notices audience filtering, report card incl. draft-exclusion, RBAC and regression). Frontend: verified admin Timetable Setup/Builder/By-teacher tabs, EntryDialog create/edit/clear, print popup, Notices CRUD UI, teacher My Timetable + dashboard notices/quick action, student portal timetable + notices, and the Class Hub report-card print popup. No functional defects found; all created test data cleaned up (verified in Mongo).

minor.issue: Always resolves the institution-default config (effective_tt_config(iid, ay, None)); per-academic-unit period overrides are ignored, so a teacher teaching a class in a unit with an override sees wrong period labels/times in 'My Timetable' and in the admin By-teacher matrix.
Any teacher of the institution can fetch any student's report card (no assignment/class scoping). Consider restricting to the teacher's assigned classes.
Attendance % is computed by scanning every attendance sheet of the class in Python (per-sheet dict lookup); will not scale — better to query only sheets containing the student / aggregate in Mongo.

issues: tt-config-badge briefly renders 'Built-in defaults (not saved yet)' before the config fetch resolves, i.e. a wrong state flash instead of a loading placeholder
Audience and Status selects start empty ('Select audience'/'Select status') although the backend defaults them to Everyone/Published — pre-select the defaults so the saved value is explicit

action_items: Make /api/timetable/teacher-grid (and the By-teacher matrix) unit-override aware, or document that it uses the institution default config
Optionally scope report-card access for teachers to their assigned classes
Optional polish: loading state for the timetable Setup badge; default Audience=Everyone / Status=Published in the notice dialog
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1852 lines — split into routers (timetable, notices/report-card, resources, auth) per the 700-line guideline

printDoc.printTimetable / TimetableBuilder / TeacherGrid pick a slot entry with entries.find(day, period_no) — when two entries share a slot with non-overlapping effective_from/to ranges (which the conflict engine legitimately allows), only the first is rendered and no date range is shown
TeacherTimetable 'Today' card and the weekly grid ignore effective_from/effective_to, so expired or not-yet-active entries are shown as if current
Conflict engine checks section → teacher → room in order and raises on the first hit; consider aggregating all conflicts in the 409 detail for a better admin UX
